stories.title: Shruti Haasan fronts The Singleton Social x Nicobar campaign
stories.summary: Diageo India platform The Singleton Social has named actor and singer Shruti Haasan as its new face. The announcement coincides with a festive gifting collaboration with lifestyle brand Nicobar, featuring three gift boxes. The platform organises experiences around music, art, culture and social gatherings.

stories.title: HP spotlights Indian innovations in Diwali campaign
stories.summary: HP has launched a Diwali campaign, Lights of Change, featuring six stories of Indian innovations. The film highlights technology solutions for agricultural waste, urban flooding, and access to education. Featured projects include a self-learning Braille device and a platform for accessible fetal heartbeat monitoring.

stories.title: Apple and Raw Mango film Diwali campaign
stories.summary: Apple has released a Diwali campaign featuring actor Juhi Chawla, created in collaboration with fashion label Raw Mango. Directed by Sanjay Garg and shot on the iPhone 18 Pro, the film uses traditional textiles and dance to depict a narrative of moving from darkness into light.

stories.title: ENVY Perfumes launches campaign with Kapoor and Dhawan
stories.summary: ENVY Perfumes has launched a campaign featuring actors Janhvi Kapoor and Varun Dhawan. The narrative focuses on an unexpected encounter where fragrance acts as a conversation starter. The brand says the partnership aims to expand its Eau de Parfum portfolio alongside its existing deodorant business.

stories.title: Hershey’s Kisses highlights Diwali party interruptions
stories.summary: Hershey’s India has launched a Diwali campaign for Hershey’s Kisses, focusing on the difficulty of finding romantic time during family celebrations. The digital film depicts a couple attempting to steal a quiet moment at a party, only to be repeatedly interrupted by family members.

stories.title: Swiss Beauty launches new festive campaign ‘We Got You’ with Taapsee Pannu
stories.summary: Festive celebrations are filled with moments people want to enjoy without interruption. Yet, the thought of whether their makeup is keeping up can pull them out of the experience. Swiss Beauty’s festive campaign, ‘We Got You’, responds to this consumer insight with a simple promise:

stories.title: Hershey’s uses AI for Diwali campaign
stories.summary: Hershey’s India has rolled out an AI-generated ad film for its Kisses brand. The campaign builds on the company’s Giving Kisses Is Hard platform, depicting a couple trying to find a private moment during Diwali. The man asks for a gift, and the woman suggests a kiss.

stories.title: KitKat targets festive chaos in new campaign
stories.summary: VML India has conceptualised a festive campaign for KitKat that addresses the mishaps of the season. The brand says that while chaos is an inevitable part of celebrations, taking a quick pause can lighten the experience. The campaign positions the chocolate as a companion for meaningful breaks.

stories.title: Kamal Haasan reflects on five decades of brand avoidance
stories.summary: Actor Kamal Haasan celebrated his 72nd birthday on November 7. For five decades, Haasan maintained a strict boundary between his artistic work and commercial endorsements, refusing to engage in advertising. He broke this pattern in 2015 by becoming a brand ambassador for a textile retailer.

stories.title: Brands shift Diwali narratives for 2026
stories.summary: Diwali 2026 advertising campaigns have shifted focus from traditional themes of family and gifting to childhood memories and overlooked moments. Notable efforts include Amazon India’s focus on reconnection and Zomato’s playful take on festive gifting. Brands are finding different ways to tell stories this year.

stories.title: Reva by PNGS names Sharvari Wagh brand ambassador
stories.summary: Reva by PNGS has appointed actor Sharvari Wagh as its first brand ambassador. The move follows a trend of jewellery brands securing film stars to represent their collections. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: GTF Technologies wins Agency of the Year
stories.summary: GTF Technologies has been named Agency of the Year at the Realty+ Conclave and Excellence Awards 2026 North. The agency, which has 18 years of experience, focuses on real estate branding and marketing campaigns. It claims to offer a comprehensive range of 360-degree services.

stories.title: AGD Gold and Diamonds signs Kunchacko Boban
stories.summary: AGD Gold and Diamonds has appointed Malayalam film actor Kunchacko Boban as its brand ambassador. The company joins other jewellery retailers in using regional cinema stars to front its marketing efforts. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: GTF Technologies wins Agency of the Year
stories.summary: GTF Technologies received the Agency of the Year award at the Realty+ Conclave and Excellence Awards 2026 North. The agency cites its expertise in building real estate brands and delivering integrated marketing solutions. It has been operating for over 18 years.

stories.title: Omnicom Media India ranked number one by RECMA
stories.summary: Omnicom Media India has been ranked first among media agency groups in the 2026 Network Diagnostics Report by RECMA. The network claims this reinforces its position in the Indian market. Three of the six highest-ranked media agencies in the country now belong to the group.

stories.title: Mark Rober uses AI as a thought partner
stories.summary: Mark Rober says his content has a moat against AI-generated slop. Despite this, he uses generative AI as a thought partner for writing and to create lessons for his science curriculum. He currently has 85 million subscribers on YouTube.

stories.title: Mark Rober on fighting AI slop
stories.summary: Mark Rober says creators can combat AI-generated content by filming real-world stunts. He argues that the knowledge that a video is real provides value that simulations cannot replicate. He also notes that AI tools can assist with tasks like video editing and language dubbing.

stories.title: The political creator economy shifts
stories.summary: The political media landscape has changed significantly since the 2024 election cycle. While influencers were once seen as the future of political media, the current environment for creators in the space remains in flux. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Audiences remain skeptical of creator disclosures
stories.summary: A Morning Consult survey of 2,000 US adults found that while 69 percent believe creators should disclose paid promotions, only 25 percent think they do so consistently. Industry experts blame this trust gap on creators who prioritise quick earnings over consistent content.

stories.title: blooloop reveals 2026 immersive influencer list
stories.summary: The fourth blooloop 50 Immersive Influencer List has been announced in partnership with Fever. The list highlights individuals in the immersive experience industry, which the organisation claims is redefining visitor expectations through deeper storytelling. The sector continues to expand into music, theatre and wellness.

stories.title: French creator economy reaches 9 billion euros
stories.summary: The French creator economy is valued at 9 billion euros in 2026, a 23.7 percent increase over the previous year. Coherent Market Insights projects the market will nearly double to 17.2 billion euros by 2029. Most creators are still filming for small change.

stories.title: Creators weigh Instagram long-form video push
stories.summary: Instagram now allows videos up to 90 minutes long to attract YouTube creators. While the platform is paying select creators to test the feature, it has provided no concrete long-term ad revenue model. Creators are currently waiting for a clear way to get paid.

stories.title: Advertisers turn to microdrama campaigns
stories.summary: India's microdrama advertising market is projected to grow from 24 crore rupees in FY26 to 210 crore rupees in FY27. While subscriptions currently account for 99 percent of industry revenue, brands are increasingly exploring episodic storytelling as an alternative to conventional product placements.

stories.title: YouTube creators support Susan Wojcicki Foundation
stories.summary: The Susan Wojcicki Foundation has launched to focus on lung cancer screening and early detection. The foundation is using YouTube creators to help spread its mission during Lung Cancer Awareness Month. The organisation aims to change the conversation around the disease.

stories.title: The rise of the influencer agency
stories.summary: Creative and media agencies are increasingly adding influencer marketing to their service offerings. While creator budgets are growing, experts suggest that treating influencer work as a simple bolt-on service often leads to poor results. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Broadcasters rely on creators for relevance
stories.summary: After Party Studios claims that traditional broadcasters need content creators more than the reverse. As viewers move toward global streamers, production companies are focusing on creator-led shows to maintain cultural relevance. Broadcasters are currently being squeezed by changing consumption habits.

stories.title: KlugKlug CEO warns of fake influencer reach
stories.summary: The Indian influencer marketing industry may have exceeded 20,000 crore rupees, but KlugKlug CEO Kalyan Kumar says brand spending is undermined by fake followers and poor creator selection. He argues that rapid industry expansion has outpaced the ability of marketers to assess creator credibility.

stories.title: TikTok adds search advertising metrics
stories.summary: TikTok has introduced new impression share metrics and keyword packs for its search ads. The platform is adopting features familiar to those who manage Google Ads, including match type reporting. The tools are designed to help advertisers target users through search queries.

stories.title: Amazon adds ads to text-based shopping
stories.summary: Amazon is introducing Sponsored Product ads into its text-based shopping agent conversations. While purchases completed by the agent remain ad-free, the chat threads themselves will host promotions. The feature is currently in invite-only testing for U.S. customers, with a wider rollout planned for the coming weeks.

stories.title: Snap reports revenue growth as ad-tech gains continue
stories.summary: Snap Inc. reported third-quarter revenue of $1.72 billion, a 14 percent increase year-over-year. The company attributed the growth to momentum in its advertising engine, which monetises Snapchat through sponsored AR lenses, video ads, and direct-response campaigns. The firm also shifted back to net profitability for the period.

stories.title: TikTok tests standalone shopping app
stories.summary: TikTok has launched a standalone shopping application focused on product discovery and purchasing. The platform is currently available only to a limited number of countries in Asia. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Meta updates marketing API with AI disclosure tools
stories.summary: Meta has updated its Graph and Marketing API to allow businesses to add or remove artificial intelligence self-disclosures from posts. The company has simultaneously deprecated other features within the platform. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Reddit tests search result ads
stories.summary: Reddit is testing advertisements within its search results to align promotions with user discovery behaviour. The platform is pursuing this strategy despite a decline in its overall search traffic. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Meta outlines US$97.5 billion AI financing plan
stories.summary: Meta has detailed a financing plan of up to US$97.5 billion to support its artificial intelligence infrastructure. The company claims these investments will improve the economics of its advertising business. The significance for advertisers remains in the company's explicit focus on AI-led commerce and consumer products.

stories.title: Meta updates Graph and Marketing APIs to version 27
stories.summary: Meta has released version 27.0 of its Graph and Marketing APIs, which enables two ad features by default and restricts location fields in lookalike audience requests. The update also blocks six legacy features for new apps and sets retirement dates for older API versions throughout 2027.

stories.title: Advertisers look to scene-level targeting for CTV
stories.summary: Advertisers are increasingly using scene-level targeting to align creative content with relevant onscreen context in connected TV. Despite a surge in streaming popularity, Wurl reports that ad fill rates are not keeping pace with content supply, leaving the ecosystem opaque for those trying to control ad placement.

stories.title: Meta AI prompts questions on conversational advertising
stories.summary: As consumers use AI assistants for product research, industry observers are weighing the potential for sponsored ads within Meta AI. While no public tests have been confirmed, analysts suggest the platform's opportunity lies in connecting AI-led discovery with its existing advertising and commerce ecosystem.

stories.title: DoorDash plans $17 billion Instacart acquisition
stories.summary: DoorDash has announced plans to acquire Instacart for $17 billion. The move follows a trend of delivery platforms diversifying into AI assistants, advertising programs, and in-store business solutions to gain market share. DoorDash has been on an expansion streak to move beyond basic delivery services.

stories.title: Brands face high costs for creator-led video series
stories.summary: Brands are increasingly sponsoring long-form original video series created by influencers. According to industry estimates, these projects can cost a brand anywhere from $150,000 to $5 million. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: MarTech explores engineering consent for marketing
stories.summary: The platform discusses the shift beyond simple opt-in models toward engineering consent for better marketing outcomes. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Hershey’s India uses AI for Diwali campaign
stories.summary: Hershey’s India has launched a Diwali campaign featuring a digital film about couples finding private moments during family gatherings. The campaign, conceptualised by TBWA\Lintas, uses the brand's existing platform to frame the product as a solution for navigating the dynamics of festive family events.

stories.title: First Insight adds AI capabilities for retail forecasting
stories.summary: First Insight has launched an MCP Server and a Storylines tool to integrate real-time consumer insights into AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. The company claims these tools allow retailers to assort and price products based on current shopper sentiment rather than relying solely on previous season data.

stories.title: ChatGPT traffic value questioned
stories.summary: Industry analysis suggests that paid traffic generated through ChatGPT currently holds significantly less value than traffic from Google. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Amazon blocks Meta’s Muse AI
stories.summary: Amazon has reportedly blocked Meta's Muse AI as shopping agents begin to challenge traditional retail advertising models. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: AI complicates marketing centralization
stories.summary: The platform examines the challenges AI poses to the centralization of marketing operations. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Turning AI productivity into marketing ROI
stories.summary: The platform provides guidance on converting gains in AI-driven productivity into measurable marketing return on investment. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Fresh Step uses AI to shorten campaign production
stories.summary: The Clorox cat litter brand Fresh Step worked with agency RECE to launch a new campaign in about a month. The company says it used AI to reduce production costs to one tenth of previous levels. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Explain Data shifts focus to customer metrics
stories.summary: Explain Data is positioning its analytics services around tracking customer actions like purchases and registrations. The company says this approach is superior to relying on traffic and engagement figures alone. It works with businesses to identify which measurements matter for individual marketing campaigns.

stories.title: Cyara launches platform to monitor AI agent quality
stories.summary: Cyara has launched the Agentic CX Trust Platform to provide independent oversight of live AI agent conversations. The company claims it can catch failures the moment they happen and ensure they never occur twice. Every production failure is turned into a test for future agents.

stories.title: Netsertive report identifies franchise marketing gaps
stories.summary: Netsertive released a report surveying franchise marketing leaders across 14 industries. It finds that the primary obstacle to franchise marketing and AI leverage is the final gap between connected systems and a single view of performance. The report includes an audit of the Franchise 500.

stories.title: Can AI agents manage influencer marketing
stories.summary: As creator partnerships grow more complex, some suggest agentic AI could help brands manage campaigns at scale. The goal is to maintain content quality and creator relevance while meeting campaign objectives. The full piece is for subscribers.
